conventions.origin: Each root is the measured reference-pose bone position; asset axes remain parallel to Blender body axes. Bone rotation must be compensated with attachment_reference_to_bone matrices before UE axis conversion.
conventions.head: head bone at source (0,-0.016597,1.272770)m; head skin width0.449723m, head top1.557142m. These are Cropout proportions, not a human-sized .25m hat assumption.
conventions.existing_hat: Existing AHearthVillager.Hat is SkeletalMesh+LeaderPose. Hide it before adding these static hats/hair; do not pass these GLBs to SetSkeletalMesh.
conventions.rigidity: Accessories are static. Reference-pose fit is checked; walk/chop/carry animation intersections and socket conversion must be tested in UE before enabling live attachment.
conventions.slots: Use one head_cover and one back item at most. Hair/hat combinations are explicit in looks.json; do not stack arbitrary hats.
conventions.reference_ownership: Original Cropout body FBX/blend remains in Saved/ThreeHearths/ResidentKitReference. ResidentKit GLBs contain original attachments only.
